name: Permis de Sejour (Business Owner / Self-Employed)

requirements.blocker_text: Haiti's DIE does not publish a distinct investor-visa or minimum-capital-linked residence category. This file models the same general permis de sejour process documented in ht_work_permit.json, with a business owner substituting their OWN company's registration/business license for the 'employer' documentation the DIE page describes -- a reasonable, disclosed inference from the source's own wording ('employer/sponsor'), not an independently confirmed distinct provision for investors specifically. The same supporting documents apply: passport photocopy, medical certificate under 30 days old, two photos, a French-translated birth certificate, a criminal record, and a Haitian bank attestation of at least 7,500 gourdes (~$200), plus a 5,000-gourde application fee.
requirements.fix_path: Register the business in Haiti and provide its registration/license in place of an employer letter when filing the general permis de sejour application with the DIE.

evidence_required.document: Business registration/license (in place of an employer letter)
Criminal record from country of origin

outcome.duration_length: not specified by the source; permis de sejour, presumed renewable

sources.title: Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Emigration (official government portal) -- general permis de sejour requirements; no distinct investor category found
